description: List every Georgia Milestones test with a blueprint: 14 End-of-Grade tests (ELA and math for each of grades 3-8; science and social studies in grade 8 only) and 4 End-of-Course tests (Algebra I, Biology, Literature II, US History). Returns `assessments` with `assessment_id`, `subject`, `grade` (null for End-of-Course), `hs_course` (null for End-of-Grade), and a readable `title`. Use the ids with get_assessment_blueprint and standards_for_claim.
name: list_assessments
title: List Georgia Milestones Tests
